newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria police find boat wreck, no trace of crew.
newsitem.headline: Austria police find boat wreck, no trace of crew.

text.p: Austrian emergency services said on Thursday they had located the wreckage of a Slovak tug in the swollen waters of the Danube but there was still no trace of eight missing crewmen.
The Slovak-registered "Dumbier" was lying not far from Vienna's unfinished Freudenau power plant, where it sank late on Tuesday after hitting a weir.
"We have not ruled out the possibility that the bodies of the crew may be below deck," a river police spokesman said.
One man scrambled to safety and is now recovering in a Vienna hospital.

The Danube remained closed in Vienna on Thursday, blocking all commercial shipping traffic on Europe's busiest east-west waterway. Emergency services said they may attempt to raise the 130-tonne wreck on Friday.

The 35-metre (115-ft) boat was pushing a barge loaded with 750 tonnes of fishmeal. It sank after crashing into floodgates then forcing its way through the weir, driven by the rain-swollen river's raging current.
Traffic along the Danube over the past few days had been light due to high water levels after recent heavy rain.
